messages.content: Find out about traffic laws in Texas.

function.name: lawsuit_search
function.description: Search for lawsuits related to a particular subject matter in a certain location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location to perform the search in.

subject.description: The subject matter of the lawsuits.

year.description: Optional. The year in which the lawsuit was filed. Default: 2024

message.content:
**Traffic Laws in Texas (as of 2024)** | Topic | Key Points | |-------|------------| | **Speed Limits** | • Posted limits apply unless otherwise indicated.
• On highways, 55–75 mph; on rural roads, 45–65 mph; on city streets, 25–35 mph.
• “No speed limit” signs allow drivers to set a safe speed. | | **Seat‑belt & Child Safety** | • All occupants must wear seat belts.
• Children under 8 must be in a child safety seat or booster appropriate for their size and weight. | | **Cell‑phone Use** | • Handheld phone use while driving is prohibited (except for emergency calls).
• Hands‑free devices are allowed. | | **Driving Under Influence (DUI)** | • Blood alcohol concentration (BAC) ≥ 0.08 % is illegal for adults; lower limits for commercial drivers and those under 21.
• Penalties include fines, license suspension, mandatory education, and possible jail time. | | **Right‑of‑Way Rules** | • At uncontrolled intersections, vehicles approaching from the right yield first.
• Pedestrians always have priority at crosswalks. | | **School Bus Regulations** | • Vehicles must stop when a school bus stops to pick up/drop off children.
• Failure to stop can result in heavy fines and points on your license. | | **Parking Restrictions** | • No parking within 20 ft of a fire hydrant, curb, or intersection.
• Parking on sidewalks is prohibited unless marked otherwise. | | **Lane‑Changing & Overtaking** | • Drivers must signal before changing lanes.
• Overtaking on the left is generally prohibited unless passing a slower vehicle. | | **Use of Headlights** | • Headlights must be used from sunset to sunrise and during inclement weather. | | **Vehicle Registration & Insurance** | • Proof of registration and insurance must be carried in the vehicle. | --- ### How to Find Recent Traffic‑Related Lawsuits in Texas If you’re interested in recent legal cases involving traffic violations or road‑related disputes, you can use the `lawsuit_search` function. For example: ```json { "location": "Texas", "subject": "traffic law", "year": 2024 } ``` Would you like me to run this search to pull up recent lawsuits?
